Timeless Group of Companies is a family-owned retail, distribution, trading, and investment group based in Dubai, founded in 2003. Its aim is to empower and elevate established and emerging brands in the retail world through distribution and strategic brand-building services. The group’s vision is to become a go-to partner for retail and distribution solutions, known for excellence, integrity, and fostering a community of thriving brands. Through subsidiaries including Times Square Group and J.S.K Trading Limited, Timeless holds exclusive distribution, procurement, and master-franchise rights for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands across the Middle East and adjacent regions. Its work spans retail, distribution, trading, investments, and real estate, connecting international brands with regional markets. The company’s values include People, Honesty, Creativity, Transparency, Operations, and Leadership. Timeless describes diversity as a strength, with a team of cultures and talents that supports creativity and innovation. Its workforce approach emphasizes inclusion, cultural diversity, mentorship, and equitable opportunity.

As a Senior Marketing Executive, you will lead integrated marketing campaigns and regional brand strategy for a retail and distribution group working with premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands. You will plan sports partnership activations, manage digital marketing channels, and coordinate events and sponsorships that strengthen brand presence across regional markets. The role combines 360-degree marketing with content planning, audience and market insight, and campaign analytics. You will oversee content production schedules and collaborate with regional stakeholders to align marketing activity with brand objectives and local market needs. This full-time, on-site position is based in the United Arab Emirates, with work connected to the group’s Dubai operations. You will bring senior-level experience, a marketing education, and the ability to connect brand strategy with effective execution across digital, social, content, and live experiences.
